d: Long, flowing midnight-blue hair with straight bangs and a small braided crown of gold beads adorns a youthful, mature face with sharp, narrow navy-blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a complex gothic-lolita ensemble featuring a dark navy bodice with gold accents, white ruffled tiers, and a wide yellow underskirt with white lace trimming. Brown opera gloves and matching thigh-high stockings with gold buckles and bows complete the outfit, complemented by gold drop earrings and a blue folding fan held in one hand.
